scheme_name: Scholarship for Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt of India
benefit: Tuition fee up to ₹2.00 lakh/year + maintenance allowance ₹3,000/month + book grant ₹5,000/year + disability allowance

criteria.label: Beneficiary Category (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 40%+)
criteria.plain_description: Applicant must have a valid Unique Disability ID (UDID) or medical board disability certificate of 40% or more.
criteria.source_clause: DEPwD Top Class Guidelines Clause 4.1 - Eligibility Criteria
criteria.remediation: Upload valid UDID card or 40%+ disability certificate issued by government medical board.

criteria.label: Admitted to recognized full-time graduate / technical course
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be pursuing full-time graduate degree program in an approved institution.
criteria.source_clause: DEPwD Top Class Guidelines Clause 4.2 - Institutions Covered
criteria.remediation: Upload bonafide certificate from the college.

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹6,00,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family annual income must not exceed ₹6.00 Lakh.
criteria.source_clause: DEPwD Top Class Guidelines Clause 4.3 - Income Ceiling

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Aadhaar must be linked for DBT payment directly to student.

application.office_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities / College Disability Cell
documents_to_carry: Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Proof
process_steps: Register via One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
Select scheme under DEPwD: Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
Upload disability certificate, college fee breakdown, and income certificate
Verification by College Head of Institution
Direct DBT grant disbursed to bank account
